title: Media Producer / Video Editor (A2-A4)
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
# **About PATI Group**

**PATI Group** is not just growing — we’re redefining what growth means in the e-commerce industry. Specializing in **dietary supplements** and sell direct to customer, we achieved **500% sales growth in just one year** in the U.S. market.

Our mission? To become **Vietnam’s leading dietary supplement company by 2026**, inspiring customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

# **Job Summary**

To scale fast, we need to create **a high volume of high-performing content**, especially product-focused visuals and scroll-stopping videos for ads and landing pages.

As a **Senior Media Producer / Video Editor**, you will take the lead in crafting **conversion-driven media** that doesn’t just look great — it sells. From attention-grabbing ad creatives to influencer-style social videos, your work will **directly impact our ad performance**, **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, **return on ad spend (ROAS)**, and the **speed of creative testing**.

This role is not about making pretty videos. It is about building **content that converts**, and being part of a team obsessed with cracking the creative code for a global audience.

# **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Video Production (70%)**

This is your core. You will take raw footage and shape it into content that performs:

- **Work closely with teams** to align video content with goals, integrating feedback constructively to deliver high-quality results.

- **Turn Footage Into Fire:** Produce short-form videos per day that stop the scroll, hook fast, and can convert (We don’t focus on measuring quantity - we reward creativity and quality of videos).

- **Edit with Edge:** Use bold transitions, AI workflows, and new tools to keep content fresh, scroll-breaking, and on-brand.

**2. Ideation (30%)**

You will have chance to bring ideas to the table that lead performance:

- **Spot Trends Before They Pop:**

Research viral formats, hooks, sounds, and styles across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

- Stay ahead of the algorithm.

- Turn trends into actions by **brainstorming 3-5 ideas daily** - with full support from team and AI-assisted tools.

# **Skills and Qualifications**

**Core Competencies**

- **Good command of English** (Listening and Spoken), equivalent to an IELTS score of 6.0.

- **Video Creating Expertise:** 1-3 years of experience in **creating video content** for **social media channels** - with a ***portfolio*** that proves you can drive specific result.

- **Platform Fluency: **Deep understanding of TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook Reels - about how they work, what pops, and what flops.

- **Editing Tool Proficiency:** Advanced skills in **CapCut** (or similar) to produce high-quality videos.

- Skilled in using **AI-powered tools** to boost creative output and streamline workflow (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway, ElevenLabs, Pika, etc.).

- **D2C Market Knowledge:** Experience working with D2C brands targeting the U.S. market is highly preferred.

**Behavioral Traits**

- **Strong creative mindset** with the ability to turn ideas into practical, engaging video content.

- **Proactive in brainstorming and contributing** content concepts with the team.

- **Collaborative Mindset:** Strong communication skills to align with team goals and open to feedback effectively.

- Always learning, driven to improve, and comfortable working in a **fast-test, fast-fail, fast-learn** environment.

- **Attention to Detail:** Committed to delivering polished, high-quality content on tight deadlines.

# **Compensation and Benefits**

- **Compensation:** Competitive salary (11,000,000 - 17,500,000 VND) + performance bonuses of up to **10 months’ salary** based on results.

- **Creative Playground:** Get your hands on bold, high-impact campaigns where your edits actually matter.

- **Dynamic Work Environment: **Work in a high-energy, collaborative team that values speed, creativity, and results.

- **Professional Development: **Access tools, mentorship, and training you need to sharpen your edge and grow your career.

- **Additional Benefits: **Social insurance, statutory leave, and a variety of wellness and team-building activities.

# **Team Management**

- **Reports to:** CEO.

- **Career Path:** Fast-track promotion to Creative Strategist or Creative Manager/Director based on results.

## **Working Location**

- On-site, 18A Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

## **Working Hours**

- **Monday - Friday:** 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- **Saturday (Culture Day):** 6:30 AM to 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

## **Employment Type**

- Full-time, On-site.
